headline: Michigan would set siting requirements for data centers
text:
Here is how your fear of AI is being used to centralize power today.

Michigan would put certain data centers under siting requirements it creates. Not passed.

117 measures in 32 jurisdictions would create an AI office, or hand an existing one new authority over AI or data centers.

198 measures in 44 jurisdictions cite the fear that anyone can now fake anyone.

2,247 measures tracked. 756 carry a control, and they would hand new power to 100 offices.
